visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a bright indoor bedroom with white walls and a white air conditioning unit mounted high on the wall. Behind him, a woman with long dark hair, wearing a dark blue long-sleeved top and dark leggings, sits on a bed with colorful bedding and plush toys. She is looking down at her smartphone, seemingly indifferent to the man's performance. (2) As the man continues to sing with increased passion, he uses his free hand to gesture towards the camera. The woman in the background shifts her gaze slightly, looking at him with a mix of annoyance and skepticism before returning to her phone. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of their clothing and the domestic setting. (3) The man leans closer to the woman, attempting to engage her in the song. The woman resumes her position on the bed, crossing her arms and looking away with an irritated pout. The camera remains static, maintaining a medium shot that captures both characters from the waist up. (5) In the final phase, the man stops singing and lowers the microphone. He pulls out a smartphone and begins playing a game with intense focus, his previous emotional state completely replaced by casual concentration. The woman looks at him with a shocked and outraged expression, her mouth agape as she realizes she is being ignored in favor of the mobile game.
